verdict.rationale: Supermemory is API-first. Official TypeScript and Python clients wrap a documented API covering ingestion, hybrid search, direct memory creation, and listing, getting, updating and deleting documents. A settings endpoint handles OAuth branding, and deletion works "via the API / console workflow." However, nothing explicitly claims UI/API parity, API keys are minted outside the consumer app (console flow), and probes found no published OpenAPI spec to confirm full coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, evidence that connector setup and API-key management are API-accessible, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
